signal.fact: Apple announced iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max on 2026-09-09; pre-orders begin 2026-09-12 and availability begins 2026-09-18.

competitor_notes: Apple already sells first-party and third-party accessories in its own store.
Retailers, carriers, review media and general AI can cover most generic comparison and accessory questions.
A generic paid guide has weak defensibility; inventory resale conflicts with current capital/owner-burden constraints.
leverage_candidates: existing marketplace or authorized affiliate distribution
event-date SEO/search pages only if they solve a narrow action gap
reusable launch-wave template for future device releases
cross-sell path research without holding inventory

predicted_next_actions: generic attention decays while owner/use accessories persist
card.monetization_hypothesis: Research-only: strongest low-capital route is likely existing-marketplace/affiliate/free-acquisition rather than inventory or a new generic guide; no live monetization is authorized.
card.kill_condition: Do not build a paid standalone product unless competitor research finds a last-mile action gap that Apple, retailers, carriers, or general AI do not already solve.

signal.fact: Microsoft states that Office 2021 support ends on 2026-10-13 with no extension or extended security updates; Office LTSC 2021 also reaches end of support on that date.

competitor_notes: Microsoft provides official migration guidance and upgrade paths.
Mature third-party migration products already exist, including MigrationWiz, Cloudiway and ShareGate in current comparison listings.
General AI can answer most generic version-check and migration questions.
leverage_candidates: reuse the deadline as training data for a general support-end/change scanner
machine-readable version and deadline checks rather than another generic guide
reusable migration-deadline templates across software vendors

predicted_next_actions: post-deadline cleanup demand persists then decays
card.monetization_hypothesis: Research-only: Office-specific generic guidance is too substitutable; more promising asset is a reusable support-end/change scanner plus action-ready checks. No live monetization is authorized.
card.kill_condition: Reject an Office-specific paid guide/tool if official Microsoft guidance, general AI, and mature migration products already solve the actionable last mile for the target segment.

signal.fact: Japan's Consumer Affairs Agency published the interim summary of the consumer contract law study group on 2026-09-10. The agency had also published a June 2026 dark-pattern consumer survey and has been examining interfaces that may distort consumer decision-making.

competitor_notes: PageAuditors and DarkLens already offer automated dark-pattern scanning.
Dokven materially narrows the previously suspected gap by combining real-browser user-journey testing, recordings and dark-pattern/legal-risk flags.
A simple URL-to-risk-score product is therefore rejected; any surviving Japan-specific opportunity must prove a distinct deterministic evidence, rule-mapping or action-completion gap.
leverage_candidates: use existing real-browser/testing infrastructure rather than rebuilding browsers
focus research on Japan-specific official-rule mapping and versioned evidence only if competitors lack it
retain as long-term research until a measurable last-mile gap is demonstrated
